title: build installs a sibling's local build only by hand
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach images (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 7)
details: The image installs each cs- tool by version from proxy.golang.org. A tool pinned at a version a clean `make ci` recorded in the local store is not there, so the image stops at `go install`. `--local-sandbox` covers cs-sandbox's own commit, and nothing covers a sibling's. It is also a flag to remember for what should be the default.
